subject: Culture
title: Sacred Offerings
description: A short lesson to help you apply Sacred Offerings.

hook.text: Balinese Hindus place daily offerings of flowers and rice on sidewalks, doorsteps, and car dashboards.

buildup.text: Offerings to gods, spirits, and ancestors exist in every faith. The logic: give to the invisible to receive protection.

discovery.text: Ancient Greek sacrifices burned the bones and fat for gods while humans ate the meat—a negotiated deal.

twist.text: The Aztec empire offered human hearts to the sun god. The gift scaled with the stakes: cosmic survival.

climax.text: Modern tithing follows the same principle. Give 10% to God and the other 90% is blessed.

punchline.text: Every offering is a transaction with the unseen.

quiz.question: What percentage does traditional tithing require?
